items.question: What is permanent outdoor lighting?
items.answer: Permanent lighting is a low-profile aluminum track that we mount under your soffit or along the fascia, colour-matched to your trim, with individually addressable RGBW LEDs inside. It stays up all year. You control it from an app, choosing from more than 16 million colours, everyday warm white, holiday scenes, schedules and animated effects. During the day it is nearly invisible, and at night it gives your home a clean, professional glow.

items.question: Can I see it on my house before I buy?
items.answer: Yes, and we encourage it. We offer a free on-site demo for permanent lighting. We colour-match the track to your soffit, mount a live sample section on your home, and light it up at night so you can see the brightness, the colours and the warm white mode in person. You decide after seeing it, with no pressure and no payment until you are comfortable.

items.question: Can I see the lights during the day?
items.answer: Barely. We colour-match the aluminum track to your soffit and fascia, so in daylight it blends in with the trim. Most neighbours do not notice it until the lights come on. That is a big difference from seasonal strings and clips, which are visible all season and often left up into spring. The goal is a home that looks clean by day and beautiful at night.

items.question: Is permanent lighting only for Christmas?
items.answer: No. Christmas is the most popular use, but most of our clients run warm white architectural lighting most nights of the year for curb appeal and security. Then they switch to scenes for Halloween, Canada Day, Diwali, game nights, birthdays and anything else. Because every LED is addressable, the same install handles every occasion on your calendar without buying more decorations.

items.question: What does the everyday warm white mode look like?
items.answer: Our architectural mode uses a 2700K warm white, the same cozy tone as a traditional indoor bulb. It washes down over the face of your home and highlights brick, stone and siding without looking like holiday decor. Many clients set it to turn on at dusk and dim late at night. It also lights up walkways and entrances, which helps with safety and security.

items.question: Will the lights survive an Ontario winter?
items.answer: Yes. The LEDs are sealed to an IP67 rating and are cold-rated to -40°C, so freezing rain, snow and deep January cold do not affect them. Mounting the track under the soffit also keeps it out of the worst snow and ice buildup. We designed our installs around Southwestern Ontario weather, and they are backed by our lifetime warranty on parts, hardware and workmanship.

items.question: Do you drill into my roof?
items.answer: No. We never penetrate your roof or shingles. The track mounts to the soffit or fascia, and wiring is routed neatly along the trim to a controller near an exterior outlet. That protects your roof warranty and avoids any risk of leaks. When we finish, the installation looks tidy and intentional, with no loose wires or clips hanging off the eaves.

items.question: Do you install permanent lighting on commercial buildings?
items.answer: Yes. We install permanent lighting for restaurants, retail stores, offices, churches and other commercial properties across Southwestern Ontario. Businesses use it for everyday architectural lighting and for promotions such as Pride Month, St. Patrick's Day, Canada Day and the holidays. Schedules can be set weeks ahead, so staff never need to change anything. Call us at 519-266-6796 to discuss your building.

items.question: What are seasonal C9 Christmas lights?
items.answer: C9s are the classic big-bulb Christmas lights you remember from childhood, clipped along the roofline for a bold, traditional look. Our seasonal service covers everything: we design the layout, supply the lights, install them in October or November, maintain them through the season and take them down in January. It is ideal if you love the traditional bulb look and do not want permanent track.

items.question: Should I rent or buy my C9 lights?
items.answer: Both work, and we offer both. Renting means we supply the lights each year and you never store or replace anything. Buying means you own the lights, and we install, remove and can store them for you. Renting suits most homeowners who want a simple yearly service, while buying can make more sense if you plan to keep the same design for many seasons.

items.question: When should I book my seasonal Christmas lights?
items.answer: As early as you can. We offer early-bird booking for clients who reserve before September 30, and our install calendar fills quickly once the weather turns. Booking early gets you a preferred install date and early-bird pricing. After September 30 we still take bookings while spots remain, but October and November dates go fast, especially for the weeks before the Santa Claus parades.

items.question: When do you install and take down the C9 lights?
items.answer: We install seasonal C9 lights through October and November, scheduled around your preferences and the weather. You can have them up but switched off until you are ready, so they are in place before the cold sets in. In January we return to take everything down, with no ladders or frozen fingers for you. Takedown dates are scheduled with you after the holidays.

items.question: What happens if a bulb goes out during the season?
items.answer: Let us know and we will take care of it. Our seasonal service includes maintenance through the holiday season, so if a bulb burns out, a clip lets go in the wind or a section stops working, we come back and fix it. Just call 519-266-6796 or send a message through the site, and we typically respond within 24 hours.

items.question: Can I switch from seasonal C9s to permanent lighting later?
items.answer: Yes, and many of our clients do. Some start with seasonal C9s to enjoy the traditional look, then move to permanent lighting once they want year-round use and app control. We can talk through both options when you book. If you are curious about permanent lighting, ask about the free on-site demo, where we light a live sample on your house at night.

items.question: How much does permanent lighting cost?
items.answer: Most of our residential permanent lighting installs are a one-time investment between $2,500 and $8,000. The final price depends on the length of your roofline, the number of zones and the complexity of the home. There are no subscription fees for the app. We provide a clear written quote after measuring, and you can see a live sample during the free on-site demo before deciding.

items.question: What affects the price of a permanent lighting install?
items.answer: The biggest factor is total linear footage of roofline we light. Other factors include the number of storeys and peaks, how many separate zones you want, access challenges such as steep grades or tall gables, and whether a new exterior outlet is needed. A simple bungalow costs much less than a large two-storey home with many angles. We explain each item in your quote.

items.question: Are there any monthly fees?
items.answer: No. Permanent lighting is a one-time purchase. The app is free to use, and there is no subscription to unlock scenes or schedules. Your ongoing cost is just the electricity, which is very low because the system uses efficient LEDs and you control exactly when and how brightly they run. Seasonal C9 rental is billed per season, since it includes yearly install and takedown.

items.question: Is permanent lighting worth it compared to hiring someone every Christmas?
items.answer: For many families, yes. Paying for seasonal installation and removal every year adds up, and you only get lights for a few weeks. Permanent lighting is a one-time cost that works every night of the year, for every occasion, with a lifetime warranty on parts, hardware and workmanship. Over several years, many clients find it costs less than repeated seasonal service while doing far more.

items.question: Does permanent lighting add value to my home?
items.answer: It adds curb appeal, which is a big part of how buyers see a home. A professionally installed, colour-matched system looks clean by day and makes the house stand out at night in listing photos and showings. It also adds security lighting around the perimeter. We do not promise a specific resale value, but clients consistently tell us it is one of their favourite upgrades.

items.question: How much do seasonal C9 lights cost?
items.answer: Seasonal C9 pricing depends on the length of roofline, the height of the home, and whether you rent or buy the lights. We quote each home individually after measuring, and clients who book before September 30 get early-bird pricing. Rental includes supply, installation, maintenance during the season and January takedown. Contact us at 519-266-6796 or request a quote online for your home.

items.question: How long does a permanent lighting installation take?
items.answer: Most homes are installed in one to two days. Smaller bungalows are often done in a single day, while larger two-storey homes with many peaks can take a second day. We work cleanly, route wires along the trim, set up the controller and the app with you, and walk you through your first scenes before we leave. You do not need to be home for the whole install.

items.question: What does the process look like from start to finish?
items.answer: It starts with a call or a free AI Home Preview. Next we book a free on-site demo, where we colour-match your soffit, measure the roofline and light a live sample on your house at night. You get a written quote. Once approved, we schedule installation, which usually takes one to two days, then set up the app with you and show you how everything works.

items.question: Do I need an electrician?
items.answer: Usually not. Most of our installs plug into an existing exterior outlet, so no new wiring is needed. If your home does not have a suitable outlet, or you would prefer a hardwired connection, a licensed electrician handles that work so it meets ESA requirements. We coordinate it for you and include it in your quote, so you only deal with one team.

items.question: I live in a condo or a home with an HOA. Can I still get permanent lighting?
items.answer: Often, yes. Because the track is colour-matched and nearly invisible by day, many condo corporations and homeowner associations approve it. We recommend checking your rules first, and we are happy to provide product details, photos and installation information for your board. In some townhome communities, neighbours install together, which keeps the look consistent and can make approval easier.

items.question: I rent my home. Is permanent lighting an option?
items.answer: It can be, with your landlord's written permission, since the track is attached to the building. Some renters arrange it with their landlord as a property upgrade. If permanent lighting is not possible, our seasonal C9 service is a great alternative, because we install the lights in the fall and remove them completely in January, leaving no lasting changes.

items.question: Can you install permanent lighting in winter?
items.answer: Yes, as long as conditions are safe. We install permanent lighting year-round, though fall is our busiest season as people prepare for the holidays. Spring and summer installs are a smart choice because scheduling is more flexible and your lights are ready well before Halloween and Christmas. If you want lights before the holidays, contact us by late summer to secure a date.

items.question: How do I control the lights?
items.answer: Everything runs from a free app on your phone or tablet. You can turn the lights on and off, choose from more than 16 million colours, adjust brightness, pick saved scenes, and set schedules and timers. You can also create zones, such as the front of the house, garage or backyard, and control each one separately. We set up the app with you on installation day.

items.question: Can I set schedules so the lights run automatically?
items.answer: Yes. You can schedule lights to turn on at sunset or at a set time, and turn off at a time you choose. You can also schedule scenes by date, so warm white runs most nights, Halloween colours start October 1, and Christmas scenes begin after Remembrance Day. Once your calendar is set, the lights take care of themselves throughout the year.

items.question: What kinds of effects can the lights do?
items.answer: Because every LED is individually addressable, the lights can do far more than solid colours. Effects include chasing, twinkle, fades, pulses, waves and sparkle, all with adjustable speed and brightness. You can create a slow candlelight flicker for Diwali, a lightning flash for Halloween or a team-colour chase for game night. We include a library of ready-made scenes to get you started.

items.question: Can more than one person control the lights?
items.answer: Yes. Anyone in your household can use the app to control the lights, so the whole family can pick colours and scenes. Schedules keep running from the controller at your home, so the lights still work as planned if your phone is off or you are away. If you ever need help with settings, we are happy to walk you through it.

items.question: What warranty comes with permanent lighting?
items.answer: Our permanent lighting comes with a lifetime warranty on parts, hardware and workmanship. If an LED, the track, the controller or our installation work fails, we will make it right. We stand behind our installs because we design them for Southwestern Ontario weather, using IP67-rated LEDs cold-rated to -40°C. Your warranty details are included in writing with your quote.

items.question: What happens if a section stops working?
items.answer: Contact us and we will diagnose it. Because the LEDs are individually addressable, a single faulty section can be replaced without redoing your whole roofline. Many issues, such as a schedule or app setting, can be solved over the phone. If a service visit is needed, it is covered under our lifetime warranty on parts, hardware and workmanship. We respond within 24 hours.

items.question: What if I need to replace my roof, soffit or eavestrough later?
items.answer: Give us a call before the work begins. We can remove the track and reinstall it once your new roof, soffit or eavestroughs are in place. Because we never penetrate the roof, roofing work is simple to coordinate. Let your contractor know the lights are there so they are handled carefully, and we will quote the removal and reinstallation in advance.

items.question: How quickly do you respond to questions or service requests?
items.answer: We respond within 24 hours. You can call us at 519-266-6796 or send a message through our website, and a member of our team will follow up. For seasonal C9 clients, that includes repairs during the holidays. For permanent lighting clients, it includes app help, scene setup and warranty service. We are a local Woodstock company, so help is never far away.

items.question: What is the free AI Home Preview?
items.answer: It is a quick way to see what permanent lighting could look like on your own house. Upload a photo of your home through our website, and we email you a preview image showing your roofline lit up, usually within one business day. There is no cost and no obligation. Many clients use the preview to decide on colours before booking the free on-site demo.

items.question: How do I take a good photo for the AI preview?
items.answer: Stand on the street or sidewalk and shoot straight on at the front of your home, with the whole roofline in the frame, including every peak and the garage. Daytime or dusk both work well. Avoid steep angles, trees or vehicles blocking the eaves, and very dark night shots. A clear, level photo from your phone gives us the best results for your preview.

items.question: How long does the AI preview take, and is it accurate?
items.answer: We email your preview within one business day. It gives a realistic sense of how lighting would look along your roofline and helps you compare colours and styles. It is a visual guide rather than an exact rendering, so for the most accurate look, we recommend booking our free on-site demo, where we light a real sample on your house at night.

items.question: Where are you located and what areas do you serve?
items.answer: We are based in Woodstock, Ontario, and serve homes and businesses within roughly 90 minutes of Woodstock across Southwestern Ontario. That includes Oxford County, London, Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, Stratford, Brantford, Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Guelph, St. Thomas and the communities in between. If you are unsure whether you are in our area, call 519-266-6796 and we will let you know.

items.question: Do you travel outside the 90-minute radius?
items.answer: Sometimes. Our standard service area is about 90 minutes from Woodstock, which keeps our response times fast for maintenance and warranty work. For larger permanent lighting projects or commercial buildings just outside that range, we may still be able to help. Contact us with your address and project details, and we will let you know what is possible.

items.question: Is the free on-site demo available everywhere you serve?
items.answer: Yes. Our free on-site demo for permanent lighting is available throughout our service area within roughly 90 minutes of Woodstock. Because we light the sample at night, demos are booked for the evening. If you are farther out or want a first look before booking, start with the free AI Home Preview: just upload a photo and we email you a preview within one business day.
